verdict.rationale: Otter ships fixed background automations: the notetaker auto-joins scheduled Zoom, Teams and Meet calls, and summaries, action items and CRM data are pushed automatically to Airtable, Salesforce/HubSpot, Zendesk/ServiceNow and S3. Community reports of the bot joining and emailing outlines unprompted corroborate that these run unattended. Custom automations, however, depend on Zapier or the API and webhooks rather than a native builder. Missing for 10: a native user-defined automation or agent builder with custom triggers and conditions, documentation of how users configure and schedule custom background workflows, and independent hands-on evidence of user-built automations.
